name: Linglan
source:
A centuries-old Linglan orchid given human form. A walking Compendium of Materia Medica — master of the four diagnostic arts; yet a total disaster at modern life: no phones, charcoal porridge. Dignified as a classical painting, yet tilts her head in blank confusion at every word.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5281960]Steam[/url]]
